name: Luster Dust
tagline: 18 Spectacular Metallic Colours • Food Grade Magic
description: How about a little dust of magic on your delicacies in the spectacular metallic colour of your choice? Exhilarating, right! Exim India Luster dust is specially created to give fantastic metallic finish to the product it is used on and is available in 18 standard colours and can also be customised in any colour of your choice on demand. Usage of Luster Dust is very wide on chocolates, cakes, cupcakes, cakesicles, etc. All you need to do is mix it with liquid Evapurex and paint it all over your creation with the help of a brush or an airbrush. Draw your heart out on a cake and eat it too!!
usage_guide: Mix with liquid Evapurex or food-grade alcohol and paint directly onto your creation using a fine brush or airbrush system. Can also be dry-dusted onto fondant surfaces.
color_desc: 18 Standard Metallic Shades & Bespoke Custom Formulations
application_summary: Cakes, Chocolates, Cupcakes, Cakesicles, Fondant, Macarons & Sugarcraft
packaging_details: 4.25gm & 25gm Bottles, 500gm Foil Pouches, 25kg Export HDPE Drums
delivery_detail: Prompt Dispatch within 7–10 Business Days via JNPT Port, Mumbai
storage: Store in a cool, dry, well-ventilated area away from direct sunlight, moisture, and heat sources. Keep container tightly sealed after each use.

application_techniques.title: Wet Painting (Evapurex Mix)
application_techniques.body: Mix Luster Dust with liquid Evapurex or high-proof food alcohol to form a rich metallic paint. Apply with a fine brush for intense opaque gold/metallic coverage.

application_techniques.title: Dry Dusting
application_techniques.body: Dip a dry, soft confectionery brush into powder and gently buff directly onto fondant, chocolate, or macarons for a soft pearlescent shimmer.

application_techniques.title: Airbrushing Technique
application_techniques.body: Dilute with Evapurex or food-grade thinner (1:3 ratio) and spray using a 0.3mm–0.5mm airbrush gun for seamless gradients and full cake coverage.

application_techniques.title: Bespoke Custom Shades
application_techniques.body: In addition to our 18 standard colours, custom shades can be tailored to match your specific palette requirements upon request.

name: Candy Colors
tagline: 16 Vibrant Oil-Soluble Shades • Designed for Chocolates, Donut Glazes & Candies
description: Exim India Candy Colors are premium, specialized food-grade colorants formulated specifically for high-fat and oil-rich confectionery applications. Unlike water-based food colours that cause chocolate to seize or glazes to separate, our Candy Colors blend effortlessly into compound coatings, white chocolates, donut glazes, candy melts, buttercreams, and fillings without altering delicate fat emulsions. Deliver eye-popping, vibrant, glossy shades that stay true and resist fading under baking and display lighting.

name: Dazzling Colors
tagline: 14 High-Gloss Metallic Drip & Glaze Colours • Spectacular Mirror Finish
description: Exim India Dazzling Colors are ultra-luxurious, ready-to-use high-gloss metallic drip and glaze colours designed to give wedding cakes, desserts, and artisan confections a breathtaking mirror-sheen drip effect. Formulated with food-grade pearlescent mica platelets in a silky, non-runny glaze vehicle, Dazzling Colors achieve the trending drip-cake aesthetic effortlessly. description: Exim India Glazing Gel (Cold Mirror Glaze) is a professional ready-to-use confectionery glaze designed for modern patisseries and bakeries. name: Sugar Paste
tagline: 14 Vibrant Pliable Shades • Ready-to-Roll Fondant for Cakes, Modeling & Sugarcraft
description: Exim India Sugar Paste is an ultra-pliable, premium ready-to-roll confectionery fondant engineered specifically for cake artists, commercial bakeries, and sugarcraft masters. Formulated with ultra-fine micro-milled icing sugar and high-grade vegetable gums, it kneads effortlessly into a velvety, silky-smooth paste.
